---
title: "RESY App"
---

Classify your plots with EUNIS-ESy or your own expert system, then explore the
rules behind each assignment. RESY runs directly in your browser through
[webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/). Your files are read inside this
browser tab and are not uploaded anywhere.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../webr/page.css">
<div id="resy-app">
  <div id="loader" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="hex">
      <img class="base" src="../logo.png" alt="">
      <img class="fill" id="hex-fill" src="../logo.png" alt="RESY">
    </div>
    <p id="loader-step">Starting R…</p>
  </div>

  <div id="tool" hidden>
    <section class="card mt-3" aria-labelledby="sys-h">
      <div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5" id="sys-h">Expert system</p>
        <div class="choices">
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="system" value="EUNIS" checked> EUNIS-ESy
            <span class="hint">European habitat types (Chytrý et al. 2020), shipped with RESY.</span>
          </label>
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="system" value="Apennine-test"> Apennine test system
            <span class="hint">A small system with five types for the example data, shipped with RESY.</span>
          </label>
          <label class="choice">
            <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="system" value="file"> Your own expert system
            <span class="hint">Expert system file, <code>.json</code> or <code>.txt</code></span>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-2" type="file" id="f-expert" accept=".json,.txt">
          </label>
        </div>
        <p id="sys-info" class="small mt-3 mb-0" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="card mt-3" aria-labelledby="data-h">
      <div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5" id="data-h">Data</p>
        <p class="small text-body-secondary">The files below are the example data shipped with RESY: 200 plots from Tuscany with 3,580 species records. Choose your own files to replace them. Files can be comma, semicolon or tab separated and of any size, such as a full EVA export; RESY reads them in parts.</p>
        <label class="form-label small d-block">Species file: one row per species in each plot
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-1" type="file" id="f-species" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,text/csv"></label>
        <div class="colpick small">
          <label>Plot <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="c-id"></select></label>
          <label>Species <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="c-name"></select></label>
          <label>Cover (%) <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="c-cover"></select></label>
          <span id="size-note" class="text-body-secondary"></span>
        </div>
        <label class="form-label small d-block mt-2">Sites file: <code>PlotObservationID</code>, plus <code>Longitude</code> and <code>Latitude</code> (WGS84) for EUNIS-ESy and the map, plus the header columns the expert system reads
          <input class="form-control form-control-sm mt-1" type="file" id="f-sites" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,text/csv"></label>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0" id="reset-data" hidden>Use the example data again</button>
        <fieldset class="options" id="eunis-opts">
          <label class="form-check-label"><input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="o-coast" checked> Flag coast and dunes</label>
          <label>Coast buffer <input class="form-control form-control-sm d-inline-block" type="number" id="o-buffer" value="5000" min="0" step="500"> m</label>
        </fieldset>
        <div class="actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="run" disabled>Classify</button>
          <label class="small">R sessions <input class="form-control form-control-sm d-inline-block" type="number" id="o-sessions" min="1" max="8" step="1" aria-describedby="sessions-hint">
            <span id="sessions-hint" class="text-body-secondary">running in parallel, one per processor core</span></label>
          <span id="status" class="small text-body-secondary"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="progress mt-2" id="progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Share of the species file classified" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" hidden><div class="progress-bar" id="progress-bar"></div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="results" hidden>
      <div class="stats mt-3">
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-plots"></b><span>plots</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-class"></b><span>classified</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-none"></b><span>no type's rule holds</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-tie"></b><span>tied at highest priority</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-time"></b><span>to classify</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="row g-3 mt-0">
      <div class="col-lg-7"><div class="card h-100">
        <div class="card-body">
          <p class="card-title h5">Plots</p>
          <div id="map" role="region" aria-label="Map of the plots coloured by type"></div>
          <div class="legend" id="legend"></div>
          <div class="actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="download-map">Download map (SVG)</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div class="col-lg-5"><div class="card h-100">
        <div class="card-body">
          <p class="card-title h5">Types</p>
          <ul class="types" id="types"></ul>
        </div>
      </div></div>
      </div>

      <div class="row g-3 mt-0">
      <div class="col-lg-7"><div class="card h-100">
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="tablehead">
            <p class="card-title h5 mb-0">Classification</p>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="search" id="q" placeholder="Filter by plot, code or name" aria-label="Filter the table">
          </div>
          <div class="tablewrap">
            <table class="table table-sm table-hover mb-0">
              <thead><tr><th>Plot</th><th>Type</th><th>Name</th><th class="num">Species</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody id="rows"></tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div class="actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="download">Download all candidates (CSV)</button>
            <span id="shown" class="small text-body-secondary"></span>
          </div>
          <ul class="warn small text-body-secondary" id="warnings"></ul>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div class="col-lg-5"><div class="card h-100" id="detail">
        <div class="card-body">
          <p class="card-title h5" id="d-title">Why this type?</p>
          <p class="text-body-secondary mb-0" id="d-empty">Select a plot in the table or on the map.</p>
          <div id="d-body" hidden></div>
        </div>
      </div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <p id="footer" class="small text-body-secondary mt-3">runs on <a href="https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/">webR</a> · <span id="workers"></span></p>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="../webr/page.js"></script>
```
